select a.BRANCH as sonFinprodId, b.AMOUNT as intAccrPrinAmt, a.VDATE as sonProdVdate, a.MDATE as sonProdMdate, a.BASIS as basis, c.DEAL_MODE prodType, D.BASIS as basis, D.YIELD as theoryYield from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT a left join PTL_SEC_POSITION b on a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.BRANCH = B.BRANCH
left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c on a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID left join (select a1.finprod_id, a1.BASIS, a1.branch, a1.YIELD, @rownum:=@rownum+1 rownum, if(@finprod_id=a1.finprod_id,@rank:=@rank+1,@rank:=1) as ro, @finprod_id=a1.finprod_id from(select @rownum:=0,@finprod_id:=null,@rank:=0)b,(SELECT * from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE order by finprod_id,EFF_DATE desc)A1 left join FIN_CASH_INFO B1 on A1.CASH_ID = B1.CASH_ID where B1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and B1.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_LX} and B1.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_LX}) d on a.BRANCH = d.branch and a.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and d.ro = 1 where a.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and b.AMOUNT > 0
